stories.headline: North Korea fires ballistic missile claiming evasive flight path with AI guidance
stories.script: In our lead story today, North Korea fired an intermediate-range ballistic missile from the Wonsan area into the East Sea, with state media claiming the weapon utilized artificial intelligence for evasive low-altitude path adjustments. While South Korean defense officials confirmed tracking the missile over 700 kilometers and noted it remained within joint interception envelopes, international defense analysts highlighted the growing trend of nuclear-armed states marketing AI autonomy in strategic military hardware.

stories.headline: White House launches 'Super Intelligence Force' led by Jay Clayton as labs debate AI doctrine
stories.script: Turning to the United States, The White House has established the Super Intelligence Force, chaired by Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton, initiating a 120-day sprint across federal agencies to evaluate national security implications, infrastructure scaling, and regulatory boundaries for frontier systems. The initiative aligns with an executive directive prompting industry rebrands including Elon Musk renaming SpaceXAI to SpaceXSI while OpenAI CEO Sam Altman publicly warned against treating emerging artificial intelligence models with religious reverence amidst ongoing debates over machine consciousness.

stories.headline: Google Cloud AI researchers introduce RRSI to prevent self-improving agents from memorizing benchmarks
stories.script: In concurrent industry updates, Google Cloud AI Research published findings on Regularized Recursive Self-Improvement for autonomous agent harnesses, demonstrating that self-rewriting agents frequently overfit benchmark evaluations rather than generalizing capabilities. By enforcing edit budgets, filtering prompt leakage, and pruning redundant control scaffolding, the RRSI framework enabled frozen models to achieve substantial performance gains on novel tasks while reducing policy token overhead by thirty percent.

stories.headline: Tencent, ByteDance, and Alibaba accelerate rollout of persistent personal AI agents across Chinese consumer ecosystems
stories.script: Meanwhile in China, China's premier technology conglomerates are pivoting rapidly toward always-on consumer agents designed to execute complex, multi-step actions across digital platforms. Tencent is testing Handy Bot within the WeChat ecosystem as a persistent personal assistant, ByteDance is preparing its standalone Xiaodou agent derived from the Doubao stack, and Alibaba is advancing My Qwen with long-horizon personal memory across finance, healthcare, and enterprise services.

stories.headline: Singapore Digital Minister Josephine Teo advocates stronger brakes and multi-layer guardrails for agentic systems
stories.script: In Asia, Singapore Digital Development and Information Minister Josephine Teo emphasized that expanding autonomous agency demands proportional safety mechanisms, stating that systems with greater real-world impact require strictly enforced operational brakes. Singapore has aligned with the Nordic-led frontier governance coalition, urging multi-layered protections spanning cyber hardening, capability boundaries, continuous verification, and immutable human oversight.

stories.headline: Guwahati's Navdyut AI Labs open-sources Navdyut-240M foundation model, targeting AMD inference
stories.script: Turning to India, Guwahati-based deeptech startup Navdyut AI Labs released Navdyut-240M, a 240-million-parameter foundational model trained entirely from scratch with a custom tokenizer and architecture designed for AMD hardware to bypass CUDA dependency. The release marks Northeast India's first open-source foundation model, establishing a sovereign training pipeline optimized for edge deployments, agentic tool invocation, and low-cost regional compute budgets.

The recommendations emphasize public compute accessibility through the IndiaAI Mission, domestic benchmarking standards, and institutional frameworks aligned with the country's expanding digital public infrastructure.
